definitions.explanation: A long, upholstered seat with a back and arms.

examples.japanese: ソファー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦くつろぐ→くつろぐ：02576_kutsurogu⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ソファー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
ソファー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧テレビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To sit on the sofa and watch TV.

notes:
ソファー refers to an upholstered seat with back and arms, typically for multiple people.

VARIANT:
ソファ (without the long vowel) is also commonly used and equally correct.

TYPES:
- 2⟦{人掛|にんがけ}→人掛：noentry⟧ソファー: two-seater sofa
- 3⟦{人掛|にんがけ}→人掛：noentry⟧ソファー: three-seater sofa
- ソファーベッド: sofa bed
- L⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ソファー: L-shaped sofa
- カウチソファー: couch sofa (with chaise section)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ソファー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit on the sofa
- ソファー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦くつろぐ→くつろぐ：02576_kutsurogu⟧: to relax on the sofa
- ソファー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}になる→横になる：05546_yokoninaru⟧: to lie down on the sofa
